'''2018 EGP Chris Kelly DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Kelly]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V)|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127135112/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
